title: "Common definitions"

Every kind shares these definitions, and each Spec page links to them.

## ObjectMeta

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `creationTimestamp` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When funcd created the object. |
| `deletionTimestamp` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | funcd does not set it. |
| `finalizers` | array of string values | funcd does not read it. |
| `generateName` | string, matching `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$` | A prefix from which funcd makes the name, adding a random suffix, when a create leaves name empty. |
| `generation` | integer | Set by funcd: 1 when the object is created, then one more each time its spec changes. |
| `name` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The object's name, unique among the objects of its kind in its namespace. A create may leave it empty and set generateName instead. |
| `namespace` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The namespace the object belongs to. A cluster-scoped kind has none. |
| `ownerReferences` | array of [OwnerReference](#ownerreference) | The objects that own this one. funcd deletes an owned object when its owner goes. |
| `resourceGroup` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The resource group the object belongs to, within its namespace. |
| `resourceVersion` | string | An opaque version of the stored object, which funcd sets. An update that sends it gets a conflict when the object changed since; compare it for equality only. |
| `tags` | map of string to string | Labels on the object, as keys and values. |
| `uid` | string | The object's unique ID, which funcd sets when it creates the object. |

## OwnerReference

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `blockOwnerDeletion` | boolean | funcd does not read it. |
| `controller` | boolean | Whether this owner is the one that manages the object. |
| `kind` | string, required | The kind of the object it names. |
| `name` | string, required, a DNS-1123 label | The name of the object it names. |
| `namespace` | string, a DNS-1123 label | The namespace of the object it names. |
| `uid` | string, required | The owner's unique ID. |

## Condition

| Field | Type and limits | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lastTransitionTime` | string, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp with exactly 3 fractional digits (2026-10-07T20:03:35.965Z) | When the status last changed. |
| `message` | string | A sentence that explains the status. |
| `observedGeneration` | integer | The object's generation when funcd set the condition. |
| `reason` | string | A short CamelCase reason for the status. |
| `status` | string, required | Whether the condition holds. |
| `type` | string, required | What the condition reports, such as Ready. |
